card.name: Start of a compound or hyphenated word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a compound word or phrase that continues straight away, such as short-term, Stubfoot, daddy longlegs, stalwart, throwaway or Sabre. It also fires on small words like 'the' inside a name or epithet.

modes.label: Split compound words
modes.description: The first part of a compound that is completed by the next piece, often a hyphen or a joined word.

modes.label: Epithet linking words
modes.description: A small word after a person's name that leads into a descriptive label.

card.plain: It marks a word that is only half written, such as the opening of a compound, where the rest must follow.
